title: India's exports just crossed $860 billion in a single year.

sources.text: News on Air (All India Radio) - Union Minister Piyush Goyal announces record $860 billion exports in FY 2025-26
India Brand Equity Foundation (IBEF) - India's exports cross US$860 billion in 2025-26

caption:
India's exports just crossed $860 billion in a single year.

India crossed $860 billion in combined merchandise and services exports for FY 2025-26, its highest ever - up from about $825 billion the year before, a 4.2% rise despite global tariff pressure.

Merchandise exports came in near $441.8 billion - engineering goods, electronics, pharma, chemicals, gems and jewellery, agri-products. Services exports reached about $421.3 billion, led by IT and digital services.

The Commerce Ministry used this record to set a new goal: $1 trillion in exports for the current year and $2 trillion by 2030. A record isn't the finish line here - it's the baseline for the next one.
